policy.official_reference_use: A human-reviewed official link is sufficient for ordinary research after checking publisher, identity, language, displayed date/version or cutoff, relevant content, and visible limitations. No saved capture or conversion is required.
policy.local_artifact_acceptance: These checks govern optional retained local artifacts only. Record a dated source within its stated scope; check a specific later change only when it may materially affect the issue. Compare extraction only as broadly as the format and intended use require. These checks do not gate a human-reviewed official link.
policy.coverage: A local artifact's accepted status does not establish topic coverage or country completion; topic evidence must still address the issue and source scope.

official_reference_review_schema.note: Record a human-reviewed official source link here when it supports a coverage layer or Directive article without a retained local copy. This record does not change the local accepted-source count. Use version_or_cutoff='not displayed' and explain the limit when the publisher shows no version marker.

rules.pass_evidence: For an official reference, record the publisher, URL, language, review date, displayed version/cutoff, relevant content, and limitations. For a retained artifact, record only the artifact checks appropriate to its format and intended reuse.
rules.semantic_validation: Hashes establish byte identity, not content fidelity. Check the passages used against the source; broader comparison is needed only for a lossy conversion or reliance on the whole converted text.
rules.attachments: Review a linked or incorporated item only when the question relies on it. Use not_applicable when no attachment is material to the reviewed scope.
rules.acceptance: Local artifact acceptance is optional and separate from official-reference use. Topic coverage and country review remain separate outcomes.
rules.no_automatic_monitor_promotion: Scheduled retrieval can stage observations only. The explicit accept action moves only records already marked accepted and passing every gate.
